name: species-strata
cmd: set -e; export BLR_DEVICE=cuda BLR_MAX_ITER=100 BLR_STARTS=0.5; FR='--incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 --strong-base --lean --tag _p96dev --target dev --save-species'; for t in 1995 1985; do for st in '' _late; do {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_${t}_s1$st --out {out}/s1_t$t$st $FR; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_${t}_ens4$st --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_${t}_s1$st --out {out}/ens4_t$t$st $FR; done; done; {python} research/exp/species_similarity.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1 --out {out}/species_similarity.csv; {python} research/exp/species_strata.py --similarity {out}/species_similarity.csv --runs {out}/s1_t1995 {out}/s1_t1995_late {out}/ens4_t1995 {out}/ens4_t1995_late {out}/s1_t1985 {out}/s1_t1985_late {out}/ens4_t1985 {out}/ens4_t1985_late --out {out}/strata.json
note: E059g: out-of-community species stratified by similarity to the focal (phylo / morph / migration / HOFI-like), seed 1 and 4-seed ensemble, selected and late, both T0s
